C:P2.1.text: About Us | The Simply Good Foods Company

C:P2.2.text: At Simply Good Foods, our mission is to empower and educate consumers about how to eat right and snack smarter through our education, advocacy, products and tools. Our vision is to lead the nutritional snacking movement with trusted brands that offer a rich variety of innovative, convenient, better-for-you snacks and meals that provide optimal nutrition for everyone.

C:P2.3.text: With our heritage of science-based nutrition, we are committed to growing our portfolio of nutritious snacking brands. We distribute our products in major retail channels including grocery, club and mass merchandise, as well as through e-commerce, convenience, specialty and other channels. Our strong platform allows us to introduce new products, expand distribution, and appeal to current and potential consumers. We are well-positioned to continue to selectively pursue acquisition opportunities in the nutritious snacking and broader health and wellness food space.
